scapy_pcap.notes: sizes/directions/IATs truncated to first 20; direction from SYN/service-port/first-packet basis recorded in protocol_metadata.direction_basis

nfstream_pcap_live.notes: src2dst orientation remapped to semantic direction; native engine Linux-only

suricata_eve.notes: EVE flow records orient/correct sensor flows; they never create flows or fabricate sequences

csv_dataset_adapters.notes: CSV sources carry no packet-level evidence; sequence fields must never be invented for them

consequences: Detector-v2 development data must be produced by replaying official PCAPs through the same adapters the runtime uses.
Sequence parity between training and inference is testable because both share the FlowEvent contract.
Aggregate CSV environments remain usable for aggregate-branch ablations but are excluded from sequence experiments.
